text:
sarah (CEO): short post-all-hands thread on the org changes + hiring plan. i've had a lot of DMs, posting the concrete bullets here. ask q's below.
jen (Recruiting): quick one 1: does this mean we pause all new postings?
dave (CTO): no full pause. we're instituting a gating step for new reqs. only roles mapped to prioritized buckets (Serving runtime, Dedicated ops, customer-impacting product) will pass until further notice.
lisa (Dir Eng): to be clear: if your team's work directly reduces latency or improves reliability we get priority. other work will be reviewed for business impact.
omar (People Ops): timeline: org sketch and manager assignments by Thu, role-to-team mappings over two weeks, hiring approvals reflow immediately after mappings.
nina (Product): how do PMs get a role fast-tracked?
jen (Recruiting): create a ticket in internal/hires -> tag @jen + @lisa and add a short note on customer impact. mark "fast-track" if tied to an active contract.
kevin (Eng): internal moves? any new process?
omar (People Ops): internal transfers encouraged. post availability in #internal-moves and cc your manager; we'll prioritize these in the triage board.
sarah (CEO): compensation bands remain. any exceptions handled by Omar + finance.
dave (CTO): hiring mix guidance: prioritize senior ICs for foundational infra work; balance with mid-level for throughput. hire juniors only when paired mentoring exists.
jen (Recruiting): interview loop note: expect leaner panels for infra roles to speed decisions; recruiters will send updated loops later this week.
kevin (Eng): sponsorship/relocation impacts?
omar (People Ops): existing offers unaffected. new reqs requiring sponsorship evaluated per-region; put that flag on the ticket.
nina (Product): will product/growth hiring stop?
sarah (CEO): not stop but slower. tie hires to measurable growth levers or customer retention to get earlier approval.
jen (Recruiting): urgent customer-facing hires: tag ticket "urgent-customer" with customer name and SLA to escalate.
oncall-bot: all-hands follow-up notes uploaded to internal drive: allhands/2026-04-02-summary.md
sarah (CEO): we'll post the org diagram and a read-only headcount bucket sheet by EOD Fri. thanks for the questions, keep them coming.
